about: Per-character render settings the server uses when the start message says backend auto/profile or omits width/height. 'local' = a Quadro K620 class card (measured by avatar/bench_profiles.py through the whole server pipeline). 'big_gpu' = a big GPU (RTX 4090 / 4070 class): NOT measured -- set from estimates (v2 fox 1280x720 spp1: RTX 4090 mid 11.0 ms, RTX 4070 mid 16.6 ms; fox is the heaviest character), so full-resolution TAA at 720p is the safe start; re-run bench_profiles on such a machine (--json ... --write-profile big_gpu) to measure it.
